disclaimer: All percentages are fictional demonstration assumptions for a prototype, not proven business results. Validate every intervention with a controlled experiment before deployment.

impact_multipliers.note: Forecast percentages apply in full to High-impact interventions and are scaled for lower-impact ones (demonstration assumption).

COMPATIBILITY.description: Customers buy accessories or devices that do not work with their existing model or equipment.
COMPATIBILITY.success_metric: Compatibility-related return share for the affected product group

pre_purchase.name: Compatibility checker
pre_purchase.description: Ask the shopper for their device model and show a clear compatible / not compatible result before add-to-cart.

pre_purchase.name: Device-model confirmation
pre_purchase.description: Require the shopper to confirm their device model at checkout for accessory orders.

pre_purchase.name: Supported-model list
pre_purchase.description: Publish an explicit, searchable list of supported models on every accessory listing.

post_purchase.name: Recommend compatible replacement
post_purchase.description: Draft a message suggesting the correct compatible variant when a compatibility return is started.

post_purchase.name: Offer one-click exchange
post_purchase.description: Offer an exchange for the compatible model alongside the normal refund option.

post_purchase.name: Route to technical support
post_purchase.description: Route compatibility questions to a technical specialist before the return is completed.

risks: Extra checkout friction can reduce conversion
Incomplete model lists can mislead shoppers

FIT_TOO_SMALL.description: Apparel or footwear runs smaller or tighter than the shopper's usual size.
FIT_TOO_SMALL.success_metric: Size-related return share and exchange-to-refund ratio

pre_purchase.name: Measurement-based size guide
pre_purchase.description: Show garment or insole measurements with how-to-measure guidance for every size.

pre_purchase.name: Runs-small warning
pre_purchase.description: Show a qualitative 'many shoppers size up' note when fit feedback indicates the item runs small.

pre_purchase.name: Review-based fit summary
pre_purchase.description: Summarize fit feedback from reviews (runs small / true to size / runs large).

post_purchase.name: Offer next-size exchange
post_purchase.description: Offer a free exchange for the next size up when a too-small return is started.

post_purchase.name: Send fit advice
post_purchase.description: Draft a fit-advice message with measurement tips for the customer's next purchase.

experiment.design: Two-week randomized A/B test on size-guide exposure

risks: Fit warnings may push shoppers to the wrong size if feedback is sparse

FIT_TOO_LARGE.description: Apparel or footwear runs larger, longer, or looser than the shopper's usual size.
FIT_TOO_LARGE.success_metric: Size-related return share and exchange-to-refund ratio

pre_purchase.name: Measurement-based size guide
pre_purchase.description: Show length, chest, and waist measurements and the model's size for comparison.

pre_purchase.name: Runs-large warning
pre_purchase.description: Show a qualitative 'many shoppers size down' note when fit feedback indicates the item runs large.

post_purchase.name: Offer size-down exchange
post_purchase.description: Offer a free exchange for a smaller size when a too-large return is started.

risks: Fit warnings may reduce conversion on items that fit most shoppers

EXPECTATION_MISMATCH.description: Colour, material, or overall appearance differs from what the listing led the shopper to expect.

pre_purchase.name: True-colour photography
pre_purchase.description: Use colour-calibrated photos in natural light, with a 'shown in daylight' caption.

pre_purchase.name: Material close-ups and video
pre_purchase.description: Add texture close-ups and short video so shoppers can judge material and finish.

pre_purchase.name: Customer photo highlights
pre_purchase.description: Surface customer-submitted photos near the main gallery.

post_purchase.name: Listing-correction feedback
post_purchase.description: Draft an internal ticket to correct the listing when expectation returns cluster on one product.

post_purchase.name: Suggest a closer alternative
post_purchase.description: Draft a message suggesting an alternative that better matches what the customer wanted.

experiment.design: Three-week randomized A/B test on gallery content

risks: Heavier media can slow product pages

DIMENSION_MISMATCH.description: The product is physically larger or smaller than the shopper understood from the listing.

pre_purchase.name: Prominent dimensions
pre_purchase.description: Show width, depth, and height in a highlighted block near the price, in the shopper's preferred units.

pre_purchase.name: Visual size comparison
pre_purchase.description: Show the product next to familiar reference objects (a person, a door, a sofa).

pre_purchase.name: Room or context preview
pre_purchase.description: Offer an in-room preview (photo overlay or AR) to check scale before buying.

post_purchase.name: Offer a better-sized alternative
post_purchase.description: Draft a message suggesting a model with suitable dimensions instead of a refund.

risks: AR previews may not work on all devices

DAMAGED.description: Products arrive broken, cracked, dented, or scratched.
DAMAGED.success_metric: Damage-related return share and replacement cost

pre_purchase.name: Fragility-aware packaging
pre_purchase.description: Choose packaging by product fragility and carrier damage history.

pre_purchase.name: White-glove delivery option
pre_purchase.description: Offer assisted delivery for large or fragile items at checkout.

post_purchase.name: Offer replacement
post_purchase.description: Draft a replacement offer as the default resolution for damaged items.

post_purchase.name: Create photo-verification workflow
post_purchase.description: Ask for a photo of the damage to speed up the claim; never use it to block a legitimate return.

post_purchase.name: Escalate fulfilment issue
post_purchase.description: Open an internal escalation with fulfilment and the carrier when damage clusters.

experiment.design: Four-week packaging pilot with matched control lanes

risks: Photo requirements could feel like friction if made mandatory

SETUP_DIFFICULTY.description: Customers cannot set up, assemble, install, or connect the product.
SETUP_DIFFICULTY.success_metric: Setup-related return share and setup-contact resolution rate

pre_purchase.name: Setup preview
pre_purchase.description: Show setup steps, required tools, and estimated time on the product page.

pre_purchase.name: Quick-start video
pre_purchase.description: Link a short setup video from the listing and the packaging QR code.

post_purchase.name: Send setup guide
post_purchase.description: Draft a delivery-day message with the setup guide and video.

post_purchase.name: Offer troubleshooting
post_purchase.description: Draft a guided troubleshooting offer when a setup contact or return is started.

post_purchase.name: Escalate to live support
post_purchase.description: Route unresolved setup cases to a live specialist callback.

experiment.design: Two-week randomized A/B test on setup-guide outreach

risks: Outreach volume can feel spammy if not targeted

DELIVERY_PROBLEM.description: Orders arrive late or delivery fails, leading the customer to return the item.

pre_purchase.name: Accurate delivery-date promise
pre_purchase.description: Show delivery windows based on real carrier performance rather than nominal service levels.

post_purchase.name: Proactive delay notice
post_purchase.description: Draft a delay notice with a new date and options before the customer has to ask.

OTHER.description: Returns with no transparent keyword match. Safe fallback: review manually; do not draw conclusions.
OTHER.success_metric: Share of returns classified as OTHER (lower means a clearer taxonomy)

pre_purchase.name: Manual review of unclassified returns
pre_purchase.description: Review a sample of OTHER returns locally to extend the taxonomy. Never share the raw comments.

post_purchase.name: Standard support follow-up
post_purchase.description: Handle through the normal returns process with no special intervention.

experiment.design: No experiment until the cause is understood
experiment.primary_metric: Share of returns classified as OTHER
